description: This file defines the ComponentMetaDataDecorator class, which extends WebSpanDecorator.StandardTags to add component-specific tags and logging to OpenTracing spans during HTTP request processing within a Java-based web service

classes.name: ComponentMetaDataDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds specific tags and logs to an OpenTracing span related to HTTP requests for the Hono component, extending functionality from WebSpanDecorator.StandardTags.

methods.name: ComponentMetaDataDecorator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with default or custom tags.

methods.name: onRequest
methods.description: Adds method, URI, and custom tags to the tracing span when an HTTP request is received.

methods.name: onReroute
methods.description: Logs rerouting events with method and URI details to the span.

methods.name: onResponse
methods.description: Sets the HTTP status code on the span after response is sent.

methods.name: onFailure
methods.description: Logs an error to the span if the request processing fails.
